landing.sign_in.description: Button at the top end of the landing page's calling card that opens the server's sign-in screen.

landing.join.description: Link in the landing page's calling card that moves down to the section on how to join; the primary action of the page while the server takes new accounts.

landing.elsewhere.link.defaultMessage: ¿Tienes una cuenta en otro servidor? Sigue desde allí
landing.elsewhere.link.description: Link in the landing page's calling card that moves down to the steps for following people of this server from an account on another server (Mastodon, Misskey, …).

landing.registrations.closed.defaultMessage: Este servidor no acepta cuentas nuevas.
landing.registrations.closed.description: Text on the landing page, in the calling card and in the section on how to join, when nobody may sign up.

landing.members.description: Count in the landing page's calling card: how many accounts this server has.

landing.since.description: In the landing page's masthead: since when the server runs. {date} is the formatted month and year, for example 'March 2026'.

landing.contact.fact.description: Link in the landing page's masthead to the account people contact about the server (the setting contact_account). {name} is its display name.

landing.progress.label.description: Accessible name of the landing page's progress line, which links to its three sections.

landing.place.title.description: Heading of the first section of the landing page: the server's description, whom to contact, and what people post.

landing.contact.title.description: Heading of the account people contact about the server, on the landing page.

landing.activity.title.description: Heading of the part of the landing page with the number of recent public posts and a few of them.

landing.activity.week.defaultMessage: Publicaciones públicas de los últimos 7 días
landing.activity.week.description: Label of the number of public posts that this server's users made in the last 7 days, on the landing page.

landing.posts.more.description: Link under the recent posts of the landing page to the local timeline.

landing.posts.failed.defaultMessage: No se pudieron cargar las publicaciones recientes
landing.posts.failed.description: Heading shown in place of the recent posts of the landing page when they could not be loaded.

landing.promise.title.description: Heading of the second section of the landing page: the server's rules.

landing.rules.none.defaultMessage: Este servidor no ha publicado ninguna regla.
landing.rules.none.description: Text in the section of the landing page on the rules, when the server has none.

landing.join.title.description: Heading of the third section of the landing page: what happens after joining, in the way the server allows, and how to follow from another server.

landing.sign_up.open.description: Link at the end of the steps of joining, to the server's registration page, when anyone may sign up.

landing.sign_up.approval.description: Link at the end of the steps of joining, to the server's registration page, when moderators approve each sign-up.

landing.sign_up.invite.defaultMessage: Crear una cuenta con una invitación
landing.sign_up.invite.description: Link at the end of the steps of joining, to the server's registration page, when only people with an invite may sign up.

landing.steps.form.defaultMessage: Introduce un nombre de usuario, un correo electrónico y una contraseña
landing.steps.form.description: Step of joining a server that anyone may join.

landing.steps.confirm_email.defaultMessage: Confirma tu correo electrónico desde el mensaje que recibas
landing.steps.confirm_email.description: Step of joining, on a server that sends email.

landing.steps.review.description: Step of joining: a moderator approves the new account before it can be used.

landing.steps.start.defaultMessage: Inicia sesión y empieza a publicar

landing.steps.apply.defaultMessage: Solicítala indicando por qué quieres unirte
landing.steps.apply.description: First step of joining a server where moderators approve each sign-up.

landing.steps.approved_email.defaultMessage: Recibirás un correo electrónico cuando te aprueben
landing.steps.approved_email.description: Last step of joining a server where moderators approve each sign-up, when the server sends email.

landing.steps.approved_sign_in.defaultMessage: Inicia sesión para ver si te han aprobado
landing.steps.approved_sign_in.description: Last step of joining a server where moderators approve each sign-up, when the server sends no email.

landing.steps.invite_get.defaultMessage: Pide un enlace de invitación a alguien de este servidor
landing.steps.invite_get.description: First step of joining a server where only people with an invite may sign up.

landing.steps.invite_open.defaultMessage: Abre el enlace y crea tu cuenta
landing.steps.invite_open.description: Second step of joining a server where only people with an invite may sign up.

landing.here.title.defaultMessage: Con una cuenta en este servidor
landing.here.title.description: Heading of the steps for joining this server with an account of its own, beside the steps for following from another server, on the landing page.

landing.elsewhere.title.defaultMessage: Con una cuenta en otro servidor
landing.elsewhere.title.description: Heading of the steps for following people of this server from an account on another server, on the landing page.

landing.elsewhere.find.defaultMessage: Busca aquí a alguien a quien quieras seguir
landing.elsewhere.find.description: Step of following from another server.

landing.elsewhere.copy.description: Step of following from another server. {handle} is an example handle of this server, such as '@alice@example.social'.

landing.elsewhere.copy_plain.defaultMessage: Copia su identificador, el @nombre@dominio bajo su nombre
landing.elsewhere.copy_plain.description: Step of following from another server, when the page has no example handle to show.

landing.elsewhere.search.defaultMessage: Búscalo en tu propio servidor y sigue
landing.elsewhere.search.description: Step of following from another server.

landing.elsewhere.search.detail.defaultMessage: Mastodon, Misskey y otros servidores que hablan ActivityPub pueden seguir a las personas de aquí.
landing.elsewhere.search.detail.description: Note under the step of searching on one's own server.

landing.powered_by.defaultMessage: Funciona con mycroblog, software libre bajo la AGPL-3.0
landing.powered_by.description: Line in the footer of the landing page that names the software the server runs and its license, before the link to its source code.
